answer:
For your Marina 94123 location, Cormorant will come with no travel fee, but they cannot give you a firm total for a Cybertruck yet.

What I found on Cormorant Mobile Detailing's own site:

* "inside and out" = The Schooner full detail - everything in the exterior wash + interior detail + spray wax.
* "polish and seal" = The Flagship - everything in the full detail + clay bar, one-step machine polish, 6-month sealant, and shampoo. That is their only machine polish - they do not do multi-stage correction / buffing / swirl removal as a separate service.

* 94123 is in their no-travel-fee San Francisco list.

* Before tax/fees, The Schooner is $219 small / $249 midsize / $299 large / $399 oversized. The Flagship is $549 / $629 / $759 / $949. Total = size-class price + add-ons + condition surcharges + any generator/timing fees + travel fee + 8.625% sales tax on everything except travel fee.

Why no firm total:

The owner has not decided which size class a Tesla Cybertruck belongs in, or whether its stainless steel panels can be polished, and that will only be settled after she has inspected one.

That means:
1. I can't assign you to large ($299) vs oversized ($399) for inside+out, or $759 vs $949 if you wanted The Flagship for polishing.
2. I can't confirm that they will polish stainless at all. They specifically exclude clay / polish / seal on matte, satin or vinyl wraps, but stainless is listed as undecided - not as offered and not as excluded.

Illustrative range only, assuming no condition surcharges, no generator/Saturday fees, and $0 travel:
* Schooner full detail: $219-$399 + 8.625% tax = ~$237.89 to ~$433.41
* Flagship polish-and-seal: $549-$949 + 8.625% tax = ~$596.35 to ~$1,030.85

Your actual quote will be set by technician inspection before start - they check size class and surcharges, show photos and new price, and if you decline you don't get the job done and don't get the $50 deposit ($150 for Flagship) back.

To settle it you will need to send a request with your Cybertruck details and have owner Ines Calloway inspect it - she replies by text/email within 4 business hours Mon-Sat 8am-6pm, and booking is only held when you pay the deposit link (12-hour expiry).
